title: The AI Daily — Morning Conversation
blurb: An American-English dialogue limited to publisher feed excerpts.
lines: Hey, welcome to The AI Daily. I'm Maya, and Ben is here with me. We've picked a few headlines from publisher news feeds to talk through.
Hi, Maya. These are short feed excerpts, not the full articles, so we'll keep the facts carefully attributed and avoid filling in the blanks.
Let's start with Google News · Anthropic. The headline is: Anthropic | History, Controversies, & Claude AI - Britannica.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Anthropic | History, Controversies, & Claude AI Britannica
That brings us to Google News · Anthropic, which has this headline: Anthropic IPO: how can I buy shares, and is it worth it? - The Guardian.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Anthropic IPO: how can I buy shares, and is it worth it? The Guardian
Next up, Ars Technica reports: Copilot is "the new OS for work," and now Office runs inside of it.
According to the publisher's excerpt, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint now live inside Copilot; always-on agents are next.
And our fourth story is from TechCrunch AI: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt.
According to the publisher's excerpt, The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking…
Before we go, here's a useful expression: keep an eye on. It means watch something for changes — like a fast-moving AI story.
Exactly. And look into means investigate further. Follow the original reporting for context. See you in the next edition.
note: AI voices reading a conservative two-host script grounded only in publisher feed excerpts. Full article claims were not independently verified.
